subject: Cross-timezone demo block rebalance & bridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasretail.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@novaanalytics.io>, Claire Jensen <claire@fastmetrics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Cross-timezone demo block rebalance & bridge

Hi all —

Thanks again for signing up for the group demo this week. We pulled the roster and noticed we have clustered attendees across three time zones (PST, EST, CET) which is creating a single overloaded evening block. To make the session useful for everyone, proposing we rebalance into two shorter windows and share a single bridge with breakout links for region-specific deep dives.

Options (all 60-minute sessions, 40min demo + 20min breakouts):
- Option A: Wed 5/5 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 CET
- Option B: Wed 5/5 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET / 01:00 CET (next day for CET) — less ideal for EU attendees

Please reply with preferred option (A/B) and whether you want the deep-dive to focus on: 1) inference cost/perf tuning, 2) private deployment & networking, or 3) model routing & fallbacks.

Attached a compact deck and a provisional bridge invite. Ben & Grace — if either of you can own the bridge host and breakout assignments, flag here and I’ll add you to the invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Option A works best for our group (12:00 ET slot). We have 3 engineers joining and one PM; they would prefer the deep-dive on inference cost/perf tuning. If possible, can we compress the live demo to ~30–35 minutes so we can spend more time on the tuning checklist?

Also please include notes on token-level cost breakdowns in the deck or send post-demo — helps us get internal buy-in.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Integrations — Atlas Retail
